explication: Clay is a dependency-free C UI layout library: an application supplies dimensions, pointer and scroll state, declares a nested UI, then consumes sorted render commands through a renderer. The core also supports text measurement callbacks, scrolling, transitions, retained-mode rendering, visibility culling, and custom elements. Renderer adapters translate commands for graphics, terminal, and document/browser targets; language bindings expose the library to other ecosystems. Core workflow is documented in the README; sampled renderer excerpts show adapter responsibilities, but do not establish wiring among individual adapters.
